description: This is a conceptual process-flow schematic illustrating the evolution from traditional liquid–liquid extraction (LLE) to modified LLE systems. The diagram uses icons and labeled arrows to show four solvent categories (aqueous H₂O, non-aqueous CₓHᵧ, synergistic, and magnetic) converging into a modified LLE vessel, contrasted with the classic two-phase separator at left. No quantitative axes or data series are present, making numerical extraction impossible.
